scope: Prior independent safety/original-source reviews plus hash-bound independent procurement/layout delta review and fresh combined native gates
qualificationGates: C14 nominal 22uF is approximately 8uF at nominal20.6V and5.5uF at28V before other tolerance/temperature/aging factors; boost stability, ripple and transient response require bench qualification.
Eaton DR74 pads fully cover actual rectangular terminals but are smaller than manufacturer recommended reflow lands; assembly process/fillets need qualification.
Regulator saturation/current limit and actual copper temperatures, switching noise, short/fault behavior and total +5V/SD load need bench checks.
Diode leakage and clamp overshoot require actual operating/fault tests; TVS/ESD nominal ratings do not certify precision ADC clamping.
230 filled/capped/planarized vias and established stackup remain mandatory.
OBD housing and M3 socket-head screw/no washer sample fit remains required.
Dedicated GPIO13 heartbeat firmware remains deferred; no vehicle-use, automotive-transient or production qualification is established.
limitations: Manufacturer review focused on changed/high-risk devices and land/pin contracts; not every passive ordering suffix was newly independently audited.
Original functional comparison and historical baseline audits were inspected as existing evidence, not independently reconstructed from the original PDF in this final delta pass.
fabricationScope: Local bounded prototype fabrication/assembly package; no order, bench qualification, vehicle-use or production qualification.
